issue.summary: Same supplier on 2 different payment terms across ERPs

plan.diagnosis: Schwaben United Supply Corp. operates across 3 ERP instances (SAP_A, D365, SAP_B) with inconsistent payment terms (Net30 and NT60), creating working capital inefficiency and duplicate payment processes. With USD 5,018,048 in annual spend, the mismatch prevents optimal cash management and exposes the company to early payment penalties or missed discount opportunities.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct payment terms benchmarking analysis for Schwaben United Supply Corp. across all three ERPs (SAP_A, D365, SAP_B) to determine contractual baseline and identify which term (Net30 vs NT60) aligns with master agreement
Negotiate unified payment terms with Schwaben United Supply Corp. based on USD 5,018,048 spend leverage, targeting standardized Net45 or early payment discount program (e.g. 2/10 Net45)
Update vendor master records in SAP_A (table LFB1 field ZTERM), D365 (Vendor payment terms), and SAP_B (LFB1 ZTERM) to reflect agreed standard terms, ensuring synchronization across all instances
Implement automated three-way matching rule and payment term validation in Coupa for all Schwaben United Supply Corp. POs to prevent future term deviations
Establish quarterly vendor reconciliation process including payment terms audit across multi-ERP environment, with Schwaben United Supply Corp. as pilot

plan.expected_impact: Standardizing payment terms across ERPs will unlock approximately USD 83,634 in annual working capital benefit (assuming 30-day improvement on 50% of USD 5,018,048 spend at 4% cost of capital) and eliminate duplicate payment processing costs.
kpis: Payment term variance across ERPs (target: 0% deviation)
Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) for Schwaben United Supply Corp. by ERP
Invoice processing cycle time reduction (target: 20% improvement)
Early payment discount capture rate if negotiated
Vendor master data accuracy score (target: 100% alignment across SAP_A, D365, SAP_B)
risks: Supplier resistance to term changes may jeopardize USD 5,018,048 spend relationship
ERP synchronization delays could create payment disputes during transition period
Existing in-flight POs with legacy terms may require manual intervention for 30-60 days
Lack of governance may allow terms drift to recur without ongoing monitoring
erp_actions: SAP_A: Update vendor master LFB1-ZTERM field to standardized payment term code for Schwaben United Supply Corp. across all company codes
SAP_B: Update vendor master LFB1-ZTERM field to match SAP_A standardized payment term code
D365: Modify vendor record payment terms in Accounts Payable > Vendors > Payment section to align with SAP standard
Coupa: Create supplier validation rule to flag any PO for Schwaben United Supply Corp. with payment terms deviating from master standard
All ERPs: Add vendor master data change workflow requiring dual approval (Procurement + AP) for any future payment term modifications
SAP_A and SAP_B: Create custom ABAP report (LFB1/LFC1 tables) to monitor payment term consistency across company codes monthly
